instruction: I notice this paper has two equal-advising senior authors. Please locate their personal webpages and save them to a bookmark folder titled 'Liked Authors' in the 'Bookmarks bar'.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('f11'); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.scroll(-20)

metadata.explanation: Task focuses on the two equal-advising authors (marked with † in paper): Yuke Zhu and Anima Anandkumar. Expected URLs verified from paper metadata and standard academic profiles. Uses existing bookmark evaluator.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts bookmark state from Chrome's Bookmarks file
Metric logic correctly verifies folder name 'Liked Authors' in bookmark_bar
Metric correctly checks for expected URLs using product combinations to handle alternative URLs
Complete coverage: checks folder name, folder location, and URL presence
Expected URLs are semantically correct - verified academic profiles for both authors from paper metadata
Practical feasibility: getter can access persisted bookmarks, no postconfig needed
Alternative URL handling is correct - provides multiple valid options per author (personal sites, institutional pages, LinkedIn, etc.)
